access_finding: three of the four families recorded as 'blocked on access' on 21 September were not blocked. DACOOP-A is on arXiv, GSTAM is open access, ATT-D3RQN needed only the proxy already available.

d05.reason: DACOOP-A's capture is d_E,i < d_c for ANY ONE pursuer, which is the predicate D06 rejects; its cooperation is encirclement, the formation mechanism the Research lead ruled out; its evader is faster than the pursuers, where D08 froze the opposite
d05.recommendation: retain DACOOP-A as the cited structural comparison for the learned-control family; the graph-and-time-native baseline is CCBS (D11)

concessions.C12_setting: urban multi-vehicle pursuit with learned spatiotemporal reasoning is prior art (E02, E03); the MOTIVATION for leaving free space is also published (E03)
concessions.C04: learned, online, balanced target allocation is prior art (E02), framed explicitly as dynamic ST-MR-IA. Closer to C04 than the access-blocked Riedmiller record, which is therefore no longer the binding constraint on C04.
concessions.C05_H2: sustained target assignment mattering in multi-vehicle pursuit is prior art AS A FINDING (E02, 'persistent spatial lock-in'), not merely as a mechanism

what_survives.C04: the FEASIBILITY FILTER over the combination. GSTAM allocates over evaders and applies no filter, because a grid cannot make an allocation physically infeasible.
what_survives.H2: whether an EXPLICIT commitment mechanism beats EMERGENT persistence. GSTAM's persistence is a by-product of expert specialisation plus a balance regulariser, reported as a diagnostic; there is no commitment memory, hysteresis or switch margin.
what_survives.temporal: no record in the corpus carries arrival times, windows or intervals. GSTAM's Temporal Mamba encodes PAST observations.

consequence_for_experiment_design: the J1-versus-J0 comparison must include a GSTAM-style EMERGENT-PERSISTENCE comparator, or it tests nothing.

verdict_composite.note: unchanged in label, materially smaller in content. Four components were conceded before this package and six are conceded after it.

still_blocked.status: no SAGE subscription; absent from Scopus as OnlineFirst
